_: Hashmap containing the key-value pairs of the form database-name: [schema-name1, maybe-schema-name2]. This comment is removed automatically.

singleUserOverride._comment: If you want to use a single user for all schemas within the same database, set this to true. You have to provide a replacement for {{SCHEMA}} token. Set passwords or leave the properties empty to generate random passwords.

owner._commentUsername: Provide a template for the user that will be the owner of all created objects. Permitted tokens: {{DATABASE}}, {{SCHEMA}}.
owner._commentPassword: Provide a custom password or leave the field empty to generate a random password.

userSetupOptions._commentAppUsers: You can provide multiple AppUser entries. This might be useful if you want to track connections from different machines.

appUsers._commentUsername: Provide a template for the user that will have read & write permissions on all created objects. Permitted tokens: {{DATABASE}}, {{SCHEMA}}.
appUsers._commentPassword: Provide a custom password or leave the field empty to generate a random password.

userSetupOptions._commentReadOnlyUsers: You can provide multiple ReadOnlyUser entries. This might be useful if you want to track connections from different machines.

readOnlyUsers._commentUsername: Provide a template for the user that will, as the name implies, only have read permissions on all created objects. Permitted tokens: {{DATABASE}}, {{SCHEMA}}.
readOnlyUsers._commentPassword: Provide a custom password or leave the field empty to generate a random password.
